sources.facts: Official monument inventory confirms the two construction phases, Otto Rehnig, Bellevuestraße and the surviving facade and relocated rooms.
The public marker describes the damage of the war and survival of the facade and historic rooms.
The first three plots form a 66 m street front. Plot 16 adds 28 m, giving a 94 m frontage and 6,430 square metres of covered area.
Measured sections record the six-level arrangement including the setback roof storey, the large courtyard and inner covered public wings.
